status: SKELETON — NOT FROZEN. This file pre-shapes the US-008 preregistration; it becomes binding only at the independently attested plan-freeze commit. Every OWNER_DECISION_PENDING field must be resolved to an exact frozen value before freeze. No results fields exist in this file, by design.

comparison_boundary.definition: Black-box TCP comparison boundary: Java and Rust implementations are exercised through identical preregistered TCP endpoints; nothing inside either process is instrumented across the boundary.
comparison_boundary.endpoint_definitions: OWNER_DECISION_PENDING (exact listen address, port allocation policy, and handshake parameters frozen at plan freeze)

workloads.title: Opening handshake and clean close
workloads.definition: Establish a WebSocket connection via the opening handshake and perform a clean close, repeatedly, with fixed operation counts.

workloads.title: Small text echo
workloads.definition: Echo small text frames over an established connection with fixed message sizes and counts.

workloads.title: Fragmented 64 KiB binary echo
workloads.definition: Echo 64 KiB binary messages delivered as fragmented frames, with a fixed fragmentation pattern.

fixed_parameters.inputs: OWNER_DECISION_PENDING (exact byte generator + fragmentation schedule, deterministic)

workloads.title: Ping/pong/close control-frame mix
workloads.definition: A fixed interleaving of ping, pong, and close control frames with data traffic.

workloads.title: Cap-before-allocation rejection
workloads.definition: Deliver frames/messages exceeding configured caps so the implementation must reject before allocating, with fixed oversize inputs.

workloads.title: Bounded concurrent connection/command pressure
workloads.definition: Bounded concurrent connection churn plus command traffic at fixed rates and concurrency limits.

pairing_and_ordering.ordering: Deterministic SHA-256-seeded randomized Java/Rust order per workload
pairing_and_ordering.seed_derivation: OWNER_DECISION_PENDING (exact seed input string — e.g. plan digest || workload id — frozen at plan freeze so the order is reproducible and unmanipulable)

statistics.per_endpoint_analysis: All 30 paired natural-log Rust/Java ratios; arithmetic mean; sample standard deviation; two-sided 95% Student-t interval with 29 degrees of freedom; exponentiated bounds.

power_model.alternatives: OWNER_DECISION_PENDING (the named memory/non-regression alternative effect sizes to be frozen)

statistics.decision_rule: Only complete predeclared paired evidence can decide; altered summaries, omissions, identity mismatches, nonfinite values, or raw-versus-summary disagreement are INCONCLUSIVE and blocking.

ci_thresholds.note: Ratios are Rust/Java; exponentiated CI bounds. 'upper<=' means the exponentiated upper 95% bound must not exceed the threshold; 'lower>=' means the exponentiated lower bound must be at least the threshold. Applied per workload.

binding.note: Canonical raw pairs must bind the plan, workload, order, environments, tools, future Java/Rust source/executable/adapter digests, and the independently rebuilt analyzer. None of these digests exist yet; none are fabricated.

results: NONE — this preregistration skeleton contains no results fields and never will; results live in canonical raw-pair records produced only after plan freeze and environment binding.
